observations: Photo 0: Nikon DSLR camera body on a wooden table; top shows 'Nikon' branding and 'D610' marking is visible on the front/top area.
Photo 1: Another front/side view of the same Nikon DSLR; body shows normal wear; no lens is clearly shown attached.
Photo 2: Rear/top view shows the camera back with a small LCD screen; mode dial is visible; no clear lens mount details or attached lens shown.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show a used camera body with cosmetic wear, but no shutter count, sensor condition, or full functionality test is shown.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible cosmetic wear/handling marks on the body surfaces.
No battery or included accessories are clearly shown in the provided photos; the rest of the bundle is cut off in the text.

risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy usage (affects lifespan and resale value).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera menu showing shutter count (or a camera shutter count report from a connected app).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used body with unknown shutter count (worst-case: higher wear).

risks.risk: Sensor dust, fungus, scratches, or haze (not visible from these angles).
risks.proof: A test photo of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) plus a close-up inspection photo of the sensor area (mirror up / sensor view).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed clean sensor (worst-case: may need cleaning).

risks.risk: Autofocus and key functions may be faulty (AF, buttons, dials, LCD, ports).
risks.proof: Short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a subject, and playback of a taken photo; plus a photo of the LCD showing clear text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully verified working (worst-case: assume issues until tested).

risks.risk: Missing or non-original accessories (battery type, charger, cables, strap).
risks.proof: Photos of all included items laid out (battery label, charger model, cables/strap) and close-ups of any serial/model numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only or incomplete bundle (worst-case: only what’s shown/confirmed).

risks.risk: Lens not included or incompatible (photos don’t clearly show a lens attached).
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens mount area clearly and a full shot of the camera with any lens attached (front + mount).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as camera body without a lens (worst-case).

proof_requests: Photo/video confirming what accessories are included (battery, charger, strap, cables) with clear labels.
Shutter count screenshot from the camera or a connected app report.
Test shots: one at f/16 of a plain surface to check sensor dust, and one normal focus shot to confirm AF.
Clear photo of the lens mount area showing whether a lens is included and which one (if any).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Nikon D610 body, but key value drivers (shutter count, sensor condition, full functionality, and included accessories/lens) are not verifiable from the provided images. To price confidently, the decisive proof items above are needed.
